learnings.title: Federal Reserve Board terminates enforcement action with Allegiant United Holdings, Nano Financial Holdings, and Nano Banc
learnings.claim: Federal Reserve Board press release enforcement20261105a (feed pubDate Thu, 5 Nov 2026 16:00:00 GMT; For release at 11:00 a.m. EST; lastUpdate November 05, 2026; read 2026-11-07) announces termination of the enforcement action with Allegiant United Holdings, LLC, Irvine California, Nano Financial Holdings, Inc., Irvine, California, and Nano Banc, Irvine California: the Written Agreement dated February 24, 2021 was terminated October 21, 2026. The release page links the Written Agreement PDF.
learnings.decision: REVIEW_ONLY: regulatory-awareness item about a single Irvine, California bank holding company group; no market-moving content and no action for Finance reports or Shorts unless a reviewer finds a specific use.
learnings.next_measurement: Record yes/no before 2026-11-14 whether any Finance report or Shorts item needs this Allegiant/Nano Banc termination citation.

learnings.title: GitHub changelog: Usage metrics API adds Copilot code review details and addressed rate
learnings.claim: GitHub changelog page 2026-11-05-usage-metrics-api-adds-code-review-details-and-addressed-rate (feed pubDate Fri, 06 Nov 2026 00:19:07 +0000; Improvement dated November 5, 2026; read 2026-11-07) states enterprise and organization repository-level Copilot usage metrics repos-1-day reports now include a copilot_code_review object with total_comments_evaluated, total_comments_addressed (addressed rate = addressed/evaluated), breakdowns review_comments_by_severity/review_tier/comment_type/customization, and total_merged_no_human_change_request_after_review. Comments are counted on PR merge day; bot PRs are usually excluded from comment evaluation; access requires the Copilot usage metrics policy and View Copilot Metrics permission.
learnings.decision: REVIEW_ONLY: relevant only if the system plan reads Copilot usage metrics (earlier learnings on totals_by_client / BYOK); no code or operational change without approval.
learnings.next_measurement: Record yes/no before 2026-11-14 whether any system workflow consumes Copilot usage metrics and would benefit from copilot_code_review addressed-rate fields.
